name: B7000001.RDB
title: Gatehouse
note: A guard hall where four corridors meet, pillars at the crossing.

name: N7000001.RDB
title: Hall of Pillars
note: A great hall of columns; the four corridors run into it.

name: B7000002.RDB
title: Bone Gallery
note: A barrow hall, a coffin in every alcove.

name: B7000003.RDB
title: Cavern Mouth
note: Natural rock: a chain of chambers with stalagmites.

name: B7000004.RDB
title: Cistern
note: A round vaulted cistern; the four lower corridors run into it.

name: N7000002.RDB
title: Crypt of Niches
note: A ring passage round a vault of coffins; one narrow way in.

name: B7000005.RDB
title: Ruined Cloister
note: A square court, columns half down.

name: N7000003.RDB
title: Sunken Arena
note: A circular fighting floor, a ring of cages and columns on a step above.

name: B7000006.RDB
title: Switchback Stair
note: A double flight down 19.2 m: upper ports N and W, lower ports N, S and E.

name: N7000004.RDB
title: Throne Room
note: A long hall to a throne on a two-step dais.

name: N7000005.RDB
title: Warren
note: A maze of crossing passages on a four-cell lattice.

name: N7000006.RDB
title: Collapsed Passage
note: A tunnel broken into caves, half of it fallen.

name: N7000007.RDB
title: Cruciform Chapel
note: A high-roofed cross: nave north-south, transept east-west, an altar at the crossing.

name: N7000008.RDB
title: Forge Hall
note: Braziers burn along a long hall of slab anvils.

name: N7000009.RDB
title: Hourglass
note: Two round chambers and a narrow neck between them.

name: N7000010.RDB
title: Library of Slabs
note: Reading stands and slab tables in ordered rows.

name: N7000011.RDB
title: Ossuary
note: A long low hall, bones heaped on every side.

name: N7000012.RDB
title: Pit Hall
note: A walled-in pit with its own ramp: the loot is below.

name: N7000013.RDB
title: Prison Block
note: A cellblock: gated cells off a long passage.

name: N7000014.RDB
title: Sump Tunnels
note: Low wet tunnels in the rock, the lower corridors all meeting here.
